title: Bursts of GitHub token requests load the server.
whatHappens: 3,265 token requests and 2,143 resource checks in 20-22Z on 17 Nov, against about 60/h normally. This matched the pool-wait peak. 243 more at 14-15Z on 18 Nov.
fix: cache one token per room until it is near expiry (proposed).
